name: SIGHT / LUMI
tagline: Eye-health companion for kids, parents, and clinics
description: LUMI (SIGHT thesis) is a Flutter eye-health companion that turns everyday screen time into measurable blink and viewing-distance data — with guardian controls and pathways for clinician review.
problem: Children spend more time on screens than ever, but parents and clinicians rarely get continuous, device-side signals about blink rate and viewing distance while kids are actually watching. Generic screen-time timers count minutes, not eye-health behavior — and clinic visits are too sparse to catch habits forming at home.
solution: LUMI wraps allowlisted YouTube / YouTube Kids / Playables content in a Watch Area that runs live face detection (Google ML Kit) for blink and distance monitoring. Metrics buffer offline in SQLite and sync to a Laravel backend so guardians can set limits, review charts, and share context with clinicians via OTP/QR — while kids stay engaged with pet gamification and daily goals.
features: Watch Area media sandbox with blink & viewing-distance tracking
Guardian account, child profiles, limits, and charts (mobile-only)
Offline metric buffering with batch sync when online
Pet gamification and daily goals for child adherence
Clinician share flow via OTP / QR
Child login codes + guardian OTP onboarding
uniqueness: Unlike pure parental-control or screen-time apps, LUMI measures clinical-adjacent eye-behavior signals during active viewing — not just elapsed minutes — and bridges home monitoring to guardian and clinician review in one offline-first mobile product built for thesis validation.

name: NULPlay
tagline: Campus music queue that actually ships
description: SACE Cares: NULPlay is NU Lipa’s campus-wide music queue and announcement system — students add and upvote Spotify tracks without accounts; admins drive playback and campus announcements from a live dashboard.
problem: Campus events and hangouts needed a shared playlist that hundreds of students could influence without friction, while still keeping playback, volume, and announcements under student-council control. Consumer jukebox apps aren’t built for open campus participation, admin Spotify Premium routing, or school-operated announcement audio.
solution: A Laravel 13 + Inertia/React monolith where anyone on campus can browse Spotify and upvote the queue anonymously. Admins run the Spotify Web Playback SDK from a secured dashboard, broadcast announcements over the same audio path (via ffmpeg-transcoded media), and manage queue policy in real time with Reverb and Redis. Live at music.nulpsace.com.
features: Anonymous student queue browse, add, and upvote
Admin Spotify Web Playback SDK control
Campus announcement audio over the same output
Real-time updates via Laravel Reverb + Redis
Queue policy and moderation tools for SACE admins
Hostinger production deploy with ffmpeg media pipeline
uniqueness: Purpose-built for a Philippine campus org (SACE) — open student participation without accounts, council-owned playback, and announcements on the same stack — instead of bolting a consumer queue onto a generic event app.

name: TAPUS!
tagline: Shop, ops, and NFC destinations in one system
description: TAPUS! is a founder-built customer shop and internal management system for custom product businesses — storefront checkout and PayMongo payments alongside admin orders, BOM inventory, and finance — plus an NFC Concierge that lets buyers claim keychains and open interactive destinations (letters, capsules, graffiti, mood, memory galleries, medical cards).
problem: Custom makers juggle a storefront, production stock, and payments in disconnected tools, while physical NFC keepsakes usually dump people on a dead URL. TAPUS! needed one system that runs the shop and the factory floor, then turns each claimed tag into a living, owner-controlled experience — not a static landing page.
solution: A PHP/MySQL platform with a customer shop (variants, cart, delivery fees, discount codes, batch-reference tracking, PayMongo hosted checkout) and a full admin suite (orders through production statuses, materials inventory with BOM, finance ledger, audit logs, passkeys/TOTP). The NFC Concierge generates claimable devices; owners configure destinations backed by Google Drive, with pass-along transfer and privacy-hardened media streaming. A Gemini Setup Guide chat helps customers configure devices — secondary to the shop and destinations product.
features: Customer shop with color variants, stock status, and checkout
PayMongo hosted checkout (card, GCash, Maya, QR Ph)
Admin orders, materials inventory, BOM, and finance
NFC claim flow + encoder/manager for manufacturing
Interactive destinations: letter, capsule, graffiti, mood, memory, medical
Passkeys/TOTP admin auth, Drive-backed media, pass-along ownership
uniqueness: Not a Shopify skin or a standalone NFC novelty — one codebase owns commerce, production math (BOM/consumption), and the post-purchase digital life of each physical tag, including first-class interactive destinations and transfer semantics.
source: Projects/TAPUS! - Customer Shop and Internal Management System

name: Karbono
description: Karbono turns everyday phone habits into an understandable carbon score — offline-first on Flutter, with aggregate sync, communities, and contribution flows toward sustainability goals.
problem: Filipinos lack an immediate, understandable way to see how daily phone habits relate to carbon impact and take a simple next action (reduce usage or contribute). Global carbon apps often assume always-online networks, ship raw usage off-device, or speak in abstract climate jargon.
solution: Open the app → see today’s carbon score in GForest-simple terms → one clear next action. On-device usage stays in SQLite; a shared carbon engine (mobile + server audit) computes grams from usage and network multipliers; only daily aggregate grams sync. Marketplace contributions (PayMongo), leaderboards, communities, and admin-managed references/goals round out the loop. Live at karbono.com.ph.
features: Offline carbon tracking (Flutter + SQLite)
GForest-simple dashboard (grams, points, mascot)
Privacy-first sync — aggregates only, not raw per-app logs
Leaderboards & communities
Marketplace browse + PayMongo contributions
Shared carbon-engine SSOT across mobile and web
uniqueness: Built for Philippine connectivity and privacy: offline-first tracking, on-device raw usage, server-audited aggregates, and a product narrative tuned to local sustainability partners — not a thin wrapper on a Western always-online footprint API.

name: PRISM
description: PRISM is a portal for Repository, Insights, and Submission Management scoped for CHED Region IV-A workflows, developed with NU Lipa CSIT Faculty.
problem: Regional higher-education offices and partner campuses juggle document intakes, review cycles, and reporting across spreadsheets and email threads — making status opaque and rework common when submissions, validations, and insights live in separate tools.
solution: A web prototype that consolidates repository storage, submission intake/review, and insight surfaces into one portal model tailored to CHED Region IV-A operational language — with schema and review artifacts iterated alongside faculty stakeholders.
features: Centralized repository for institutional submissions
Upload / review workflow surfaces for evaluators
Insights-oriented reporting views
CHED R4A–aligned data model (schema iterations)
Faculty-facing prototype for validation with NU Lipa CSIT
uniqueness: Not a generic DMS — PRISM is framed around CHED regional submission and insight loops, co-shaped with campus faculty rather than sold as off-the-shelf document storage.

name: NULP Student Heatmap
description: An interactive choropleth / heatmap of NU Lipa student distribution and demographics — cleaned from enrollee address data and demoed to National University’s President.
problem: Leadership needed a clear geographic picture of where NU Lipa applicants and enrollees come from. Raw spreadsheets and PDFs couldn’t communicate density, municipal coverage, or outreach gaps in a meeting-ready visual.
solution: A Python data pipeline that cleans enrollee addresses, joins Philippine municipality GeoJSON, and generates interactive choropleth / heatmap HTML maps for decision-makers — short-cycle tooling for a high-stakes campus demo.
features: Address cleaning & mapping scripts (v1/v2)
Municipality GeoJSON choropleths
Interactive HTML heatmap outputs
Enrollee vs applicant dataset handling
Meeting-ready visuals for university leadership
uniqueness: Campus-specific geo analytics built from NU Lipa’s own enrollee data and Philippine administrative boundaries — not a generic BI template — delivered as a focused leadership artifact.

name: NUtify
description: NUtify v2 is NU Lipa’s unified faculty-appointment platform — students book, teachers manage queues, moderators run the front desk, and admins operate the system — as a PWA with optional AI guidance.
problem: Faculty consultation and appointment flows were fragmented across chat threads, walk-ins, and legacy mobile clients. Students needed reliable booking; teachers needed queues and schedules; front desk needed approvals — without maintaining brittle Flutter apps.
solution: A Laravel 13 + Inertia/React web platform with role-based spaces (student / teacher / moderator / admin), session auth, OTP reset, FCM web push + PWA, optional Reverb realtime, and a Gemini-backed NUtify Guide — porting legacy API behavior into a maintainable service layer.
features: Role-based portals for students, teachers, moderators, admins
Faculty search, booking, inbox, and teacher queues
Front-desk approvals for moderators
FCM web push + installable PWA
OTP password reset and session auth
NUtify Guide AI router (Gemini + safe fallback)
uniqueness: White-label campus ops for NU Lipa (branded theme/copy) with four real operational roles and a PWA path that replaces deprecated mobile clients — not a generic Calendly clone.

name: NULP Tabulation
description: A dedicated tabulation system for NU Lipa’s Ambassador and Ambassadress pageant — built for live event scoring reliability under stage pressure.
problem: Pageant nights demand fast, trustworthy score aggregation across judges and categories. Spreadsheets and ad-hoc forms break under pressure — ties, late scores, and public reveals need a system that won’t scramble mid-show.
solution: A private web tabulation system tailored to NU Lipa’s pageant flow: structured judge inputs, category tallies, and controlled reveal-ready results for organizers running Ambassador / Ambassadress 2025.
features: Judge score capture for pageant categories
Realtime / event-night tabulation workflow
Organizer-controlled result views
Private client deployment for campus events
Scoring model aligned to NU Lipa pageant rules
uniqueness: Event-specific scoring software for a campus pageant — not a generic contest SaaS — optimized for one night’s operational reality rather than multi-tenant gymnastics.

name: Washette
description: Washette is a business and order-management system for Washette Laundry Services — tracking orders and day-to-day laundry operations in a structured database-backed flow.
problem: A local laundry service needed more than handwritten slips and chat orders — staff needed consistent order records, status, and operational queries without a heavy enterprise suite.
solution: A focused order and business-management system grounded in a relational schema for Washette’s laundry workflows — capturing orders and operational data so the business can track work beyond paper notebooks.
features: Order capture and status tracking for laundry jobs
Relational schema for Washette business entities
Operational queries for day-to-day service work
Lightweight footprint suited to a small local business
uniqueness: Scoped to a single laundry SME’s real order vocabulary — not a multipurpose POS — emphasizing operational clarity over retail feature bloat.
